arc_quest.objective.epic_branch_choice.p: Defeat 3 Blazes to Prove Your Strength
arc_quest.quest.epic_branch_choice.desc:
A fork in the road lies before you — choose wisely, for there is no turning back.

Each path demands a different sacrifice.
arc_quest.quest.epic_branch_choice.title: §e§lThe Crossroads of Fate
arc_quest.quest.epic_chapter1.desc:
Unearthly sounds echo from the depths of the mine.

Steel your nerves and descend into the abyss to uncover the truth.
arc_quest.quest.epic_chapter1.title: §6§lChapter I: Shadows Beneath the Stone
arc_quest.quest.epic_chapter2_combat.des:
You have chosen the path of war — a direct assault upon the Nether Fortress.

May the flames forge your legend, or consume you whole.
arc_quest.quest.epic_chapter2_exploratio:
You have chosen the path of discovery — the ocean monument beckons.

Beneath the waves lie ancient secrets and forgotten power.
arc_quest.quest.epic_finale.desc:
All roads converge here — the hour of reckoning is at hand.

Face the Ender Dragon and etch your name into eternity.
arc_quest.quest.epic_finale.title: §5§lFinale: The End of All Things
arc_quest.quest.epic_prologue.desc:
The village trembles under the relentless assault of the undead.

Take up arms and drive back the darkness before all is lost.
arc_quest.quest.epic_prologue.title: §6§lPrologue: The Village Under Siege
dialogue.epic_blacksmith.start.default: §fSpeak your needs. My craftsmanship is the finest in the village!
dialogue.epic_blacksmith.start.early:
§fHey, rookie! Need weapons?
I only have stone gear for now, but it's enough for early battles.
§e(Stone Sword x1 = 5 gold)
dialogue.epic_blacksmith.start.late:
§bWow, you completed Chapter 1?!
Looks like you're a serious adventurer.
Check out these diamond wares!
§e(Full Diamond Armor Set = 100 gold)
dialogue.epic_blacksmith.start.legendary:
§5§lA Legendary Hero arrives!
§fIt is my honor to forge equipment for you.
Behold my finest work — Netherite gear!
§e(Netherite Ingot x1 = 200 gold)
dialogue.epic_blacksmith.start.mid:
§7Oh? You've started exploring the mines?
Then you'll need better equipment!
§e(Full Iron Armor Set = 50 gold)
dialogue.epic_merchant.shop_menu.text:
§a§l=== Merchant's Shelves ===

§fPlease select the category of goods you wish to purchase:
dialogue.epic_merchant.start.choice_brow: Let me see what you have
dialogue.epic_merchant.start.default: §fWelcome to my shop! A wide variety of goods await~
dialogue.epic_merchant.start.phase_chapt:
§8Heading to the mines? A wise choice is to bring enough torches.
Anything could happen in the darkness...
§e(Torches x32 = 5 gold)
dialogue.epic_merchant.start.phase_defen:
§cHeard zombies are coming to attack?
These healing potions might save your life!
§e(Healing Potion x2 = 10 gold)
dialogue.epic_merchant.start.phase_gathe:
§fOff on an adventure, adventurer?
Bring some food. You might get hungry on the road.
§e(Bread x4 = 2 gold)
dialogue.epic_village_elder.branch_intro: Tell me about the Path of Combat
Tell me about the Path of Exploration

§6§lTwo paths, two destinies...

§c[Path of Combat]
Assault the Nether Fortress directly, facing Blazes and Wither Skeletons.
Suitable for warriors who love intense combat.

§9[Path of Exploration]
Uncover the secrets of the Ocean Monument, solving ancient puzzles.
Suitable for adventurers who love discovery.

§eWhat is your choice?
dialogue.epic_village_elder.chapter1_acc:
§b§lChapter I: Whispers of the Abyss

§fAncient secrets lie hidden in the depths of the mine...
Prepare torches and weapons. Beware of cave spiders!

§eObjectives: Collect Coal x16, Sticks x8
dialogue.epic_village_elder.decline.text:
§fNo matter. Return when you are ready.
The village gates are always open to you.
dialogue.epic_village_elder.explain_comb:
§c§lPath of Combat: Trial by Fire

§fYou will face:
• §6Blazes§r - Flame emissaries of the Nether
• §4Wither Skeletons§r - Terrifying fortress guards
• §5Nether Fortress§r - A dangerous labyrinth

§eRewards: Netherite scraps, powerful combat skills

§cWarning: This path is fraught with danger, but the rewards are great!
dialogue.epic_village_elder.explain_expl:
§9§lPath of Exploration: Echoes of the Deep

§fYou will discover:
• §3Guardians§r - Sentinels of the Ocean Monument
• §bPrismarine Materials§r - Mysterious ocean energy
• §eElder Guardian§r - The final boss of the temple

§eRewards: Trident, Heart of the Sea, ancient knowledge

§9Tip: Prepare potions of water breathing!
§6§lThe gears of fate begin to turn...

§fLong ago, this world was filled with peace and prosperity.
But with the awakening of the Ender Dragon, dark forces rose once more.
The undead army stands at our gates. We need a hero...

§eWill you become our hope?
dialogue.epic_village_elder.prologue_acc:
§a§lQuest Accepted!

§fFirst: Collect §6Oak Logs x5
Second: Return to me for further instructions

§eGood luck, warrior!
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.chapte:
§b§lIncredible... You defeated the mine guardian!
§fNow you face an important choice:
§c• Path of Combat: Assault the Nether Fortress
§9• Path of Exploration: Seek the Ocean Monument
Your choice will determine your ultimate fate...
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.choice: I am ready. Give the order!
I wish to learn more about these choices
Please, tell me what has happened.
I will complete it as soon as possible
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.legend:
§5§l✨ Legendary Hero ✨
§fYou did it! The Ender Dragon has been vanquished, and peace restored.
Your name shall be forever remembered in these lands!
§e(Received Hero of the Village effect + 100 XP)
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.newcom:
§fWelcome, stranger. I am the guardian of these lands.
If you are ready, I can tell you the truth about this world...
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.phase_:
§c§lWARNING! The zombie army approaches!
§fTake up your arms and defend our home!
§e(Received Strength Potion x1)

§fAdventurer, gather wood and craft weapons!
The zombie horde may strike at any moment. We must be prepared.

§fExcellent, you have armed yourself.
Now, let me inform you of the next step...
dialogue.epic_village_elder.start.prolog:
§a§lWell done, warrior!
§fThe prologue is complete, but the true challenge has just begun.
Strange echoes come from the depths of the mine... Are you ready to explore?

§eTreasures await in the mine depths. Ready to explore?

dialogue.epic_wandering_trader.start.leg:
§5§l✨ Legendary Hero! ✨
§fNever thought I'd meet the one who defeated the Ender Dragon!
§eMy humble shop is honored. Please browse freely!
dialogue.epic_wandering_trader.start.new:
§fHey there, new face! I'm a traveling merchant.
§eIf you're just starting out, I can give you some advice...
dialogue.epic_wandering_trader.start.pro:
§fOh? You've accepted the Elder's quest?
§ePrologue in progress... Good luck, adventurer!
